title: Making Small Code LLMs More Efficient for Secure Code Review with Neuro-Symbolic Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI coding assistants generate more code, the need to review it for security flaws grows. Existing approaches leave a gap: static analyzers identify program sites but offer little explanation, while language-model explanations can be difficult to verify. Small open-weight code models could make security review available without sending proprietary code to a hosted service. We study whether fine-tuning helps these models turn security evidence into explanations that developers and tools can check. We present secSemScan, which pairs a static analyzer with a locally deployable model that writes a schema-constrained security monologue naming program sites, assigning a CWE, and giving a machine-parseable verdict. We also introduce OGSM (Oracle-Grounded Security Monologue), a dataset of 1,993 C/C\texttt{++} functions covering 22 CWEs in the taint and lifetime families. translated_title: 通过神经符号微调使小型代码大语言模型在安全代码审查中更高效
translated_abstract: 随着AI编程助手生成越来越多的代码，对其安全缺陷进行审查的需求也不断增长。现有方法存在空白：静态分析器能够识别程序位置但几乎不提供解释，而语言模型生成的解释则难以验证。小型开源权重代码模型可以在不将专有代码发送到托管服务的情况下实现安全审查。我们研究微调是否能帮助这些模型将安全证据转化为开发者和工具可以核查的解释。我们提出了secSemScan，它将静态分析器与一个本地可部署的模型配对，该模型生成受模式约束的安全独白，指明程序位置、分配CWE编号，并给出机器可解析的判定结果。我们还介绍了OGSM（基于Oracle的安全独白）数据集，包含1,993个C/C++函数，涵盖污点类和生命周期类的22个CWE。每条记录将一个函数与来自分析器或修复差异的安全证据配对……
tldr: 该论文提出secSemScan系统，通过神经符号微调将静态分析器与本地部署的小型代码模型结合，使其能生成可验证的、模式约束的安全审查解释，并构建了包含1,993个C/C++函数、覆盖22类CWE的OGSM数据集。
